title: Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining
abstract:
arXiv:2610.00053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global 
vfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local 
vfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine 
vfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. translated_title: 面向快速FP4预训练的格式感知融合
translated_abstract: 四位浮点数（FP4）Tensor Core可以加速矩阵乘法，但缩放因子计算、操作数打包、布局构建以及反向传播中保存的状态可能会抵消这一收益。我们提出了格式感知融合，将每个量化生产者与其缩放域和消费者布局进行协同设计，以支持原生mxfp、全局nvfp以及协作线程数组局部nvfp。我们使用bfloat16输出投影和编译的交叉熵，在1600亿token上评估了Llama-3系列8B模型的预训练。在匹配的相同加速器探测中，bfloat16和Transformer Engine nvfp分别达到18.8K和27.6K tokens/s/GPU，而我们最快的定制路线达到37.9K。采用行梯度随机舍入和固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预条件的mxfp达到37.2K tokens/s/GPU（bfloat16模型FLOP利用率为86.3%），最终训练损失终点比原始bfloat16高2.11%。一种Transformer Engine配方……
tldr: 该论文提出格式感知融合方法，通过将量化操作与其缩放域和消费者布局协同设计，使FP4预训练吞吐量达到37.2K–37.9K tokens/s/GPU，约为bfloat16基线的两倍，同时训练损失仅比bfloat16高2.11%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes format-aware fusion, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout, boosting FP4 pretraining throughput to 37.2K–37.9K tokens/s/GPU—roughly double the bfloat16 baseline—while ending training only 2.11% above the bfloat16 loss endpoint.
